title: Post-Panamax Stress Disorder
summary:
Post-Panamax Stress Disorder
On its 99 th birthday, the expansion of the Panama Canal poses an existential question for its namesake tanker sector. Speculation on the obsolescence of the segment is a timely topic of discussion since the commission of a third set of post-Panamax locks is due in late next year, or early 2015. While historically engaged in regional, dirty trading, Panamaxes must now face a different course.
